question: Why was Little Boy so inefficient?
answer: Only 1.5% of Little Boy's uranium split; the other 98.5% was scattered as radioactive waste. Even so, the bomb released 16 kilotons of energy.
move: Little Boy wasted 98.5% of its uranium and still released 16 kilotons.
